description:
Join a mission-focused software development team supporting a critical intelligence reporting platform relied upon by government organizations and mission partners worldwide. This application manages the lifecycle of mission-critical intelligence reporting requests, from submission and tracking through administration and archival.
 As a Full Stack Developer, you will enhance, maintain, and modernize an established enterprise application while ensuring its reliability, performance, and integration with multiple interconnected systems. You'll work alongside engineers, system administrators, and mission stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable solutions in a fast-paced operational environment.
 Salary: 92,000 - 115,000 
 Active Clearance w/ Poly Required 
 Responsibilities
 Develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise web applications using modern Java technologies.
 Support the sustainment and modernization of an existing production codebase.
 Design, develop, and consume RESTful APIs to enable communication between enterprise applications.
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and performance issues.
 Maintain and improve interfaces between multiple interconnected systems.
 Develop front-end features using Angular and support legacy components as needed.
 Build backend services using Java 17+, Spring Boot, and enterprise development best practices.
 Work with Oracle and MongoDB databases to develop, optimize, and troubleshoot application functionality.
 Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment activities.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, mission-focused software solutions.
 Requirements 
 Experience developing full stack Java applications in enterprise environments.
 Strong proficiency with:
 Java 17+
 Spring Boot
 Oracle Database
 MongoDB
 Angular
 RESTful web services
 Experience supporting and maintaining existing production applications.
 Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multiple integrated systems.
 Understanding of enterprise application architecture and system integrations.
 Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
